evidence: Crystallographic structures of the grown films were investigated by X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements. Chemical compositions of the TiO2 and ZrxTiyO2 films were analyzed by taking depth profiles using Auger electron spectroscopy. Film thickness was determined by cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images and Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) depth profiles. The current–voltage (I-V) and capacitance–voltage (C-V) measurements were performed using a semiconductor parameter analyzer (HP4156A) and an LCR meter (HP4163) at 10 kHz, respectively.
